# TapTap

> > TapTap is a global mobile game discovery platform connecting 60M+ gamers with 120k+ games through community reviews, ratings, and developer services.

TapTap operates as both a consumer platform for game discovery and a developer center offering SDKs, payment processing, and backend services. The platform aggregates user reviews and ratings across Android and iOS games, serving as a trusted discovery destination for mobile gamers worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Mobile Gaming
- Game Discovery
- User Reviews & Ratings
- Android/iOS Games
- TapTap Platform
- TapSDK
- TapPayments
- Casual Games
- Idle Games
- Puzzle Games
- Free-to-Play
- Game Community
- Brain Training
- Game Backend Services
- TapDB

## Platform & Developer Services

- [TapTap - Games worth discovering](https://www.taptap.io): Main TapTap platform: discover 120k+ games with reviews from 60M+ gamers
- [TapTap Developer Center](https://developer.taptap.io): TapTap Developer Center with SDK, TapPayments, and game backend services
